classification.collision_basis: True only when this changed depot path intersects SB's pre-rebase exact-path shadow or an upstream source for a keyed override.

dispositions.adapt-sb-contract-runtime-pending: No direct path collision, but the changed upstream contract requires SB-owned adaptation and remains Engine pending until the runtime matrix is run.
dispositions.merge-required: A reviewed semantic collision must be merged into the SB-owned override; no separate runtime-only claim is attached to this row.
dispositions.merge-required-runtime-pending: A reviewed semantic collision must be merged, and the resulting engine behavior remains Engine pending.
dispositions.removed-unused-by-sb: The upstream path was removed and the SB source audit found no reference to it.
dispositions.repin-reviewed-sb-surface: The SB surface was reviewed as semantically retained; refresh its upstream pin without importing unrelated source-file or formatting drift.
dispositions.upstream-owned-no-sb-action: The changed path is upstream-owned, has no SB collision, and needs no SB code port.
dispositions.upstream-owned-runtime-pending: No SB code port is required, but the affected engine or UI behavior remains Engine pending in the OB1 runtime matrix.

subsystems.ai-and-economy: AI strategy, state value, construction, hiring, or wage behavior.
subsystems.core-script: Shared script definitions that do not fit a narrower reviewed group.
subsystems.diplomacy-and-subjects: Diplomacy, power blocs, acceptance, or subject relations.
subsystems.events-and-content: Events, history, scripted effects, or content modifiers.
subsystems.interface-and-graphics: GUI, shaders, icons, and other presentation assets.
subsystems.map-and-pathfinding: Adjacency, line, or spline pathfinding data.
subsystems.naval-and-military: Naval, ship, invasion, repair, or military behavior.
subsystems.politics-and-society: Interest groups, ideology, law, journal, or society content.
subsystems.war-support-and-war-goals: War support, war-goal, and enforcement contracts.
